title: Complete minimal submanifolds of the non-compact Riemannian symmetric spaces SL_n(R)/SO(n), Sp(n,R)/U(n), SO*(2n)/U(n), SU*(2n)/Sp(n) via complex-valued eigenfunctions
summary: In this work we construct new multidimensional families of complete minimal submanifolds, of the classical non-compact Riemannian symmetric spaces SL_n(R)/SO(n), Sp(n,R)/U(n), SO*(2n)/U(n) and SU*(2n)/Sp(n), of codimension two.
